primary_recommendation.selection_basis: Highest target score WITHIN the Pareto frontier (ties broken by the route/round/experiment/candidate composite key ascending, because candidate_id repeats across rounds). No frontier member was removed by this choice.
primary_recommendation.cross_route_comparability_disclaimer: Cross-route target-score ordering is INDICATIVE ONLY. Each route normalizes its soft score against its own executable objective contract; the normalized values are not directly comparable between routes (red line 6). This ranking is used solely to pick the primary recommendation INSIDE the Pareto frontier -- it never removes any solution from the frontier, and every frontier member remains part of the delivered portfolio.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: A 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack with individually optimized thicknesses can achieve higher emissivity in 8-13 μm than in 3-5 μm on a Si substrate, with the contrast arising from destructive interference in the target band and constructive interference in the suppressed band.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | si substrate (20 dielectric layers total, alternating starting with HfO2)

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 5 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness for the 10.5 μm central wavelength of the high-emissivity band, then optimizing within ±8% bounds, will reduce search entropy and recover or exceed the iteration_01 best score of 0.8903 by maintaining constructive interference in the target band while suppressing the 3-5 μm band.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2] × 8 | Si substrate (16 finite layers, alternating starting with HfO2)

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 5 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to ±12% of quarter-wave optical thickness at 10500 nm center wavelength, combined with L-BFGS local optimization, will refine phase alignment without expanding the thickness envelope and recover or exceed the Round 3 best score of 0.9057.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2)_8 | Silicon substrate, 16 finite layers total, alternating sequence fixed

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 5 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Constraining the central spacer layers (layers 3-7) to a narrower 250-420 nm thickness range will increase the cavity quality factor and sharpen the emissivity peak in the 8000-13000 nm band while maintaining out-of-band suppression in 3000-5000 nm.
